emails.subject: Roasting days?
emails.body: Hi, I'm thinking of ordering more beans and want them as fresh as possible. Which days do you roast, and how long until an order reaches me? Nadia (order 10481 last week)
emails.note: answered from the shop's own knowledge, nothing invented

without.reply:
Hi Nadia,

Thanks for reaching out! We roast fresh beans twice a week – on Tuesdays and Thursdays.  
After we receive your order, we ship Monday-through-Friday, and deliveries typically arrive within 3–5 business days.

If you place a new order, it will be roasted on the next scheduled roast day after we receive it, and then shipped out on the next business day.

Feel free to let us know if you’d like to place another order or have any other questions.

Best regards,  
Mill Street Coffee Roasters

with.reply:
Hi Nadia,

Thanks for reaching out! We roast our coffee on **Tuesdays and Thursdays**. Once an order is placed, we ship it Monday-through-Friday, and it typically arrives within **3–5 business days**.

If you place a new order soon, we’ll get it into the next roasting day and have it on its way shortly after.

Best regards,  
Mill Street Coffee Roasters
